answer: Among n = 3f + 1 bonded validators, each participant must anchor stake as collateral, thus forging a garden of Sybil identities demands locking proportional capital. Since any two commit quorums of size 2f + 1 intersect in at least f + 1 members, one honest thread in that overlap detects equivocation, making malicious quorum intersection impossible whenever Byzantine stake stays below one third. Slashing burns collateral B so an adversary holding fraction β < 1/3 faces negative expected utility βG - B < 0, hence honest validation dominates as a robust Nash equilibrium.
